title: Systematic-search agent skill and workflows
claim_boundary: Compiler-verified local workflow, handoff and deterministic authority behaviour only. The downstream caller and registry packet are prepared but unapplied and unsubmitted; no supported-host/model, human-calibration, companion adoption, live-provider or registry-acceptance claim is made.

assertions.statement: Publish SKILL.md with trigger and non-trigger boundaries
assertions.permitted_claim: The local skill entrypoint has deterministic trigger, non-trigger, authority and failure-routing checks; host discovery and model behaviour are not claimed.

assertions.statement: Add planning, strategy, PRESS, execution, screening and reporting references
open_gates: Run scenario-based agent evaluations across supported hosts and models.
Calibrate authority and failure modes with human information specialists.
assertions.permitted_claim: Planning through reporting stages and conservative authority gates are compiler-checked locally; host/model behaviour and human calibration are not established.

assertions.statement: Create subagent role cards and handoff contracts
assertions.permitted_claim: Seven bounded role cards and a compiler-checked, digest-bound least-context handoff contract exist locally; handoffs do not confer operational authority.

assertions.statement: Add scenario, prompt-injection and authority tests
open_gates: Run the scenario suite across every declared supported host and model before making behavioural compatibility claims.
assertions.permitted_claim: Twelve deterministic cases exercise the real Rust evaluator and replay-safe fixture authority, including prompt-injection, forged, mis-scoped, expired, revoked, replayed and human-authority denials; model and host behaviour remain untested.

assertions.statement: Integrate into academic-research-skills as a thin caller
open_gates: Obtain downstream academic-research-skills maintainer adoption and consumer-test evidence after licence and upstream-drift review.
assertions.permitted_claim: A Searchright-authored thin-caller packet is prepared locally and statically checked; it has not been applied to or validated by the downstream companion repository.

assertions.statement: Publish skill registry packets after observed validation
open_gates: Obtain explicit registry-submission authorization and an observed acceptance receipt before claiming publication.
assertions.permitted_claim: A content-digest-bound registry packet is prepared and validated locally; it remains explicitly unauthorized and unsubmitted.
